narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A slanting thread is shorter than a straight one, because it looks closer.
<bookmark mark='tilt'/>Slide why upwards and measure the tilted thread. The ruler reads more than seven centimetres.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A slanting thread must go across the floor and up the side as well, so it is longer.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>A thread running straight across a rectangle is the shortest, and a diagonal is the longest.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. A rectangle is twelve centimetres long and five centimetres wide. How long is the shortest thread across it?
